item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
This is bland. Like, really bland. Like unsalted, potato-flavored diet gruel bland. Downvote, and I frankly wonder where those other ~60 upvotes came from. This is some pretty weak tea here, even accounting for the fact it's a few years old.

In an effort to be productive, the individual genres should have a more significant effect on reality. The monochrome light spectrum thing and the no oxygen thing are cool; this needs more of that. But honestly even if you re-write most of the individual effects, I'm just not sure the core concept is strong enough.

For real. Can someone explain this one's appeal?
